theorem_title: Realize a 3SUM solver on the word RAM
formal_statement: theorem Light.Sec3.realized_threeSum : ∀ (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), Light.SolvedIn Light.s3Task T → ThreeSumApsp.WordRam.Realized EndStatement.ThreeSum T := by sorry
natural_language_statement: Every solver of the structured integer 3SUM task with running-time function \(T(n,U)\) yields a solver of the source word-RAM 3SUM specification with constant-factor overhead. The proof verifies the input layout and output verdict, then applies the existing verified compiler realization theorem.
